title.narrative: Strengthen Media Institutions in Climate Adaptation and Mitigation and Disaster Preparedness and Response

description.narrative: Member States will be supported, through strengthened media institutions, in their efforts for climate adaptation and mitigation and disaster preparedness and response. This will be achieved primarily by improving the institutional strategies, capacities, and practices of media to effectively inform and engage the public on issues related to climate change and disasters. Media will be equipped to go beyond being mere conduits for expert and scientific message, and instead shed light on the complex and often transboundary environmental issues, related obstacles and solutions, and hold the powerful to account for their actions or inaction. Media will also be better able to harness the power of digital tools, including artificial intelligence, for data gathering, analysis, and content production, while upholding journalistic standards and principles even in emergencies. With enhanced access to reliable media content throughout the disaster management cycle, from prevention and preparedness to response and recovery, people, particularly the most vulnerable, will be better equipped to make informed decisions, and more resilient in the face of extreme weather events and disasters.
